ball_by_ball.innings: Innings number (1: First innings, 2: Chase, 3-4: Super Overs)
ball_by_ball.over_ball_num: Ball number within current over (1 to 10 including extras)
ball_by_ball.striker_id: Unique player ID of the batter facing
ball_by_ball.striker_name: Full legal name of the batter
ball_by_ball.bowler_id: Unique player ID of the bowler delivering
ball_by_ball.bowler_name: Full legal name of the bowler
ball_by_ball.runs: Runs scored strictly off the bat (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6)
ball_by_ball.is_wicket: Boolean flag indicating whether a dismissal occurred
ball_by_ball.dismissal_type: Specific cricket dismissal method (Caught, Bowled, LBW, Stump, RunOut)
ball_by_ball.extras1_runs: Primary extra runs awarded to batting team

matches.match_id: Primary key for each match fixture
matches.knock_out: Binary indicator (1 for knockout/elimination, 0 for round robin)
matches.second_inn_revised_overs: Revised total legal deliveries for innings 2
